equipments.name: Rusty Butter Knife
equipments.description: Barely suitable for spreading jam, let alone slaying monsters. Smells faintly of old cheese.

equipments.name: Tattered Moth-Eaten Rags
equipments.description: Holds together by sheer hope and spiderwebs. Provides zero protection against weather or claws.

equipments.name: Cracked Wooden Lid
equipments.description: An old barrel lid with a splintered handle. Will likely disintegrate upon taking a single hit.

equipments.name: Cardboard Boots
equipments.description: Soggy cardboard bound with twine. Melts instantly in puddles.

equipments.name: Smashed Cooking Pot
equipments.description: A dented iron pot worn on the head. Echoes loudly when struck.

equipments.name: Iron Soldier Sword
equipments.description: Standard-issue militia blade. Reliable, sturdy, and sharpened on a river stone.

equipments.name: Sturdy Leather Tunic
equipments.description: Boiled leather armor offering decent protection against minor beasts.

equipments.name: Novice Oak Staff
equipments.description: A carved branch of white oak imbued with faint spark of ambient mana.

equipments.name: Apprentice Cotton Robes
equipments.description: Dyed blue robes worn by first-year academy spell students.

equipments.name: Iron Buckler
equipments.description: A small round iron shield capable of deflecting glancing blows.

equipments.name: Steel Broadsword of Valor
equipments.description: Forged in regional artisan smithies with folded high-carbon steel.

equipments.name: Chainmail Hauberk
equipments.description: Interlocking steel rings distributing impact force across the torso.

equipments.name: Runic Sapphire Wand
equipments.description: Tipped with a polished blue sapphire that channels mana currents smoothly.

equipments.name: Hunter's Leather Boots
equipments.description: Supple deer-hide boots allowing silent movement through dense brush.

equipments.name: Bronze Horned Helm
equipments.description: A ceremonial bronze helmet adorned with small ram horns.

equipments.name: Vanguard's Runed Greatsword
equipments.description: Etched with ancient runes of strength that glow faintly during combat.

equipments.name: Plate Cuirass of the Sentinel
equipments.description: Gleaming steel plate armor worn by elite fortress guardians.

equipments.name: Starlight Archmage Staff
equipments.description: Captures starlight in its crystal apex, unleashing concentrated arcane beams.

equipments.name: Amulet of Vital Focus
equipments.description: A polished silver pendant resonating with inner life force.

equipments.name: Shadowstep Leather Greaves
equipments.description: Enchanted to lighten the wearer's footsteps and boost dodging agility.

equipments.name: Sun-Forged Solar Blade
equipments.description: Forged under direct solar eclipses, radiating searing heat and radiant energy.

equipments.name: Abyssal Dragonscale Armor
equipments.description: Crafted from the iridescent scales of a subterranean abyss drake.

equipments.name: Grimoire of the Void Sovereign
equipments.description: Whispers dark secrets of the cosmos to any wizard brave enough to read it.

equipments.name: Crown of Celestial Insight
equipments.description: Floating golden circlet that expands mental clarity and spell resonance.

equipments.name: Ring of Eternal Storms
equipments.description: Crackles with contained lightning, boosting combat speed and magical output.

equipments.name: Excalibur, Blade of the Holy Dawn
equipments.description: The legendary sovereign sword of ancient hero kings. Cuts through darkness effortlessly.

equipments.name: Aegis of the Sun Empyrean
equipments.description: An impenetrable barrier blessed by solar deities. Deflects all malevolent magic.

equipments.name: Staff of the Cosmos Weaver
equipments.description: Channels the expansion of nebulae and galaxies directly into cataclysmic spells.

equipments.name: Valkyrie's Feathered Wings
equipments.description: Radiant celestial wings granting divine flight speed and unmatched dodging agility.

equipments.name: Armor of the Undying Titan
equipments.description: Forged from primordial meteoritic ore. Makes the wearer nearly indestructible.

equipments.name: Ragnarok, World-Ending Greatsword
equipments.description: Carries the apocalyptic weight of collapsing dimensions within its jagged obsidian edge.

equipments.name: Yggdrasil's Eternal World Root Staff
equipments.description: Carved from a living bough of the world tree, pulsing with infinite universal mana.

equipments.name: Cuirass of the Astral Phoenix
equipments.description: Rebuilds itself instantly from sacred embers whenever struck by lethal force.

equipments.name: Amulet of Omniscient Time
equipments.description: Allows the wearer to perceive combat fractions of a second before they occur.

equipments.name: Boots of Dimensional Striding
equipments.description: Bends space with every stride, allowing instant repositioning across the battlefield.

equipments.name: Grand Divine Sword
equipments.description: The absolute pinnacle of divine smithing. Forged by celestial architects to vanquish dark forces.

equipments.name: Genesis Tome
equipments.description: Contains ancient magic knowledge. Grants absolute dominion over arcane and divine spellcraft.

equipments.name: Time Weaver Robe
equipments.description: Woven from the tapestry of eternity itself. Time bends around the wearer, rendering physical and magical harm trivial.

equipments.name: Celestial Sovereign's Infinite Crown
equipments.description: Radiates the absolute authority of the high heavens. Inspires unconditional awe and unstoppable power.

equipments.name: Wings of the Absolute Creator
equipments.description: Six blazing wings of pure divine light that span across dimensions, transcending physical limits entirely.
